title: Sensor Observation
description: Canonical event contract between Namratha's vision-bridge and Michael's API. Namratha -> Michael, frozen per responsibility(1).md section 5.2. No breaking change without agreement from both producer and consumer.

building_id.description: Canonical building identifier from Michael's building spine. Never invent a parallel identifier.

space_id.description: Optional zone/floor identifier, e.g. floor-02-lobby. Null if the event is building-wide.

event_type.description: Only deterministic, countable event types. Not a place for free-text AI narration.

value.description: Numeric magnitude of the event, e.g. person count.

evidence_tier.description: T1 direct observation (our cameras), T2 official record, T3 proxy/inferred, T0 no evidence. Must match build_vitals.py's tiering.

confidence.description: Model/detector confidence for this observation, not a vibe score.

source.description: e.g. camera:lobby-2f. Must match a camera id in configs/cameras.yaml.

expires_at.description: When this observation should no longer be treated as current (freshness window).
